question: Which of the following union territories has the least literacy rate according to the Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dadra and Nagar Haveli.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The literacy rate in **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** was approximately 76.2% according to the 2011 Census.
 
• The literacy rate in **Daman and Diu** was around 87.1%.
 
• The literacy rate in **Lakshadweep** was about 92.3%.
 
• The literacy rate in **Andaman and Nicobar** Islands was approximately 86.6%.
